items.t: "what i want though is the distill on our character system … name the system and give it a code name that i will use. formal name and code name … give me the dope sheet on it and give me your analysis suggestions ways forward and important things that i need to remember"
Chief ruled: "LEECHSEED is the official name". The spoken code name is SISWET. Written docs keep LEECHSEED.
LEECHSEED stores a character in twelve layers, L1 CORE to L12 FUNCTION. Chief ruled the name on 10/5, replacing "12-layer".
Three tiers set the depth. Tier 1 covers L1-L3, Tier 2 covers L4-L6, and Tier 3 covers L7-L12 for leads.
The script computes seven statistics and five flags from the layers. It writes one Structured Data Block per character.
State diffs change the record over story time. A diff records what differs at one fabula event.
The sources sit in `ShroomsQ/_CANON/_SSOT/02_CHARACTER_SYSTEMS/`. That folder holds 12 docs, about 380 KB.
The EUROPATCH bay holds the twelve layers as twelve modules, with 41 dials and 6 archetype presets. Claude built v1 on 10/31.
Two scripts exist in `_tools/leechseed/`. `heritage.py` rolls heritage and `continuity_check.py` checks drafts against canon.
The interface catalog lists 149 character rows. 130 are built, 16 are parked, and 3 are proposed.
Only one character has gone through the pipeline. Victoria "Tori" Midnight has 58 of her 126 block keys parked as the VM fill pass.
Anna Colson Conway has a canon node and a record stub only. No other cast member has a slice.
Seven contradictions sit between the docs. Truth Exposure Index uses two formulas, and three number scales compete.
Eight planned field modules stand unbuilt. The layer L2b MORPHOLOGY has no home in the module registry.
Four stale status lines remain in the spine, LOOK, state architecture, and eros synthesis. A script can refresh them.

paragraphs.main_effort: Close the seven contradictions and the ruled-but-never-applied list in one batch, then prove the system on Tori and Anna.

phases.t: **System closed.** Chief closed the character system at 1.0 or above with zero open marks under BOLO 100.
**Name ruled.** Chief ruled LEECHSEED as the character system's name, replacing "12-layer".
**Heritage rolled.** Chief ruled option W1-B, and Claude built `_tools/leechseed/heritage.py` to roll L7 heritage.
**Patch bay built.** Claude built EUROPATCH v1 with the twelve layers as modules. It locks after Chief opens it.
**Distill and names done.** Claude read the twelve docs and gave naming recs. Chief ruled LEECHSEED official and SISWET the code name.
**Dope sheet and ways forward.** Claude published this sheet and gave the analysis; Chief ruled the official name LEECHSEED and the spoken code name.
**Way 1, close the seams.** One writer fixed the contradictions and the never-applied rulings; the spine went to 3.5.0; a script found 0 stale hits and 256 good links.
**Then the proof.** Claude filled Tori from sources (24 high + 21 med fields, markers 105 → 70, Step 3 passes) and ran Anna through the pipeline (43 filled, Step 3 passes, Step 1 still red).
**Way 2, the patch bay as front door.** Chief opens the bay. Claude loads Tori's values and checks the roll reproduces her statistics.
**Way 3, trim to a core.** A script counts field use. Claude runs it only after way 1, because it risks the rebuild-from-scratch stall.
